title: Seared Tuna Bowl with Spicy Korean Sauce
description: A quick and flavorful bowl dish featuring seared tuna, spicy Korean sauce, and a bed of lush greens.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, ginger, and Korean chili flakes.
Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add tuna steaks and sear for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Transfer tuna to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Add sliced green onions to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, or until slightly softened.
Pour the Korean sauce into the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
To assemble the bowls, place a bed of lush greens on a plate, followed by a seared tuna steak.
Pour the spicy Korean sauce over the tuna, then sprinkle with sesame seeds.
